verdict.rationale: Shopify's UCP checkout flow documents an explicit consent gate: complete_checkout may only be called once 'Checkout status is ready_for_complete,' 'Buyer has reviewed and confirmed the order,' and 'Payment credential has been collected,' with escalation paths that route the buyer to continue_url for review when API-only completion isn't sufficient. UCP's AP2 integration adds cryptographically signed payment mandates 'mathematically tied to the specific state of the cart,' matching the signed-mandate part of the story, and complete_checkout is gated to Token-tier agents explicitly granted purchase permission. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification that 'buyer reviewed and confirmed' is enforced (not just self-declared) for 'trusted agents' who can complete checkouts directly, and more detail on the AP2 mandate UX in practice.
